text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first crown of the Tiara route, the 
Oka Sho. The Trainer offers words of 
encouragement to Mejiro Ramonu so she 
won't be crushed by the weight of 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Mejiro Ramonu showed no sign of 
tension. Achieving the Triple Tiara was 
merely a proof of love.
Even if she missed 
it, her love would never run dry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer was impatient to achieve
their 
long-cherished dream. As a simple race 
enthusiast,
they entrusted their hopes for 
the Triple Tiara to Mejiro Ramonu.
